what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in Georgia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 25908 Ukrainian refugees in Georgia, 0.5% of all refugees from Ukraine.
The largest numbers of Ukrainian refugees live in Germany, Poland, Czechia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in every year.
Before that, it records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory in Ukraine from 2014 to 2022, with the DPR, the LPR and the United Armed Forces of Novorossiya.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1997 at 5 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 29914, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Georgia.
These are year-end totals for Georgia only, reported to UNHCR.
